name: Elemental Disciple
body:
Creatures born with the blood or benediction of natural forces can end fusing themselves with the world’s energies, either on the mortal plane or beyond it.

Requirements

To qualify to become an elemental disciple, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Cannot be a creature with an elemental subtype or template (aerial, aqueous, chthonic, or fiery).
Skills: Knowledge (nature) 5 ranks.
Languages: Aquan, Auran, Ignan, or Terran (depending from the chosen element).
Feats: Elemental Focus, Elemental Spell (both with the chosen element).
Spellcasting: Able to cast 1st-level spells. A sorcerer or bloodrager with this prestige class must have the deep earth, elemental, djinni, efreeti, marid, shaitan, or stormborn bloodline. If the character gains levels of sorcerer or bloodrager after taking this class, she must take the chosen bloodline.
Class Skills

The elemental disciple’s class skills are Climb (Str), Fly (Dex), Intimidate (Cha), Knowledge (nature, planes) (Int), Perception (Wis), Survival (Wis), Swim (Str), and Use Magic Device (Cha)

Skill Ranks at Each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Hit Die: d10.

Table: Elemental Disciple
Level	Base Attack Bonus	Fort Save	Ref Save	Will Save	Special	Spells per Day
1st	+0	+1	+0	+1	Blood of the elements, natural armor increase +1	—
2nd	+1	+1	+1	+1	Ability boost (Con/Dex +2), bloodline feat, elemental assault	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
3rd	+2	+2	+1	+2	Elemental form (1/day)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
4th	+3	+2	+1	+2	Ability boost (Con/Dex +2), natural armor increase +2	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
5th	+3	+3	+2	+3	Bloodline feat, darkvision 30 ft.	—
6th	+4	+3	+2	+3	Ability boost (Str +2)	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
7th	+5	+4	+2	+4	Elemental form (2/day), natural armor increase +3	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
8th	+6	+4	+3	+4	Ability boost (Wis +2), bloodline feat	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
9th	+6	+5	+3	+5	Elemental movement	—
10th	+7	+5	+3	+5	Elemental form (3/day), darkvision 60 ft.	+1 level of existing spellcasting class
Class Features

All of the following are class features of the elemental disciple prestige class.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency

Elemental disciples gain no proficiency with any weapon or armor.

Spells per Day

At the indicated levels, an elemental disciple gains new spells per day as if she had also gained a level in a spellcasting class she belonged to before adding the prestige class. She does not, however, gain other benefits a character of that class would have gained, except for additional spells per day, spells known (if she is a spontaneous spellcaster), and an increased effective level of spellcasting. If a character had more than one spellcasting class before becoming an elemental disciple, she must decide to which class he adds the new level for purposes of determining spells per day.

Blood of the Elements

An elemental disciple adds her level to her sorcerer or bloodrager levels when determining the powers gained from her bloodline. A character with levels in both bloodrager and sorcerer must choose which class stacks with her elemental disciple levels to determine her bloodline powers. If the elemental disciple does not have levels in sorcerer or bloodrager, she instead gains bloodline powers of a sorcerer bloodline chosen among deep earth, djinni, elemental, efreeti, marid, shaitan, or stormborn, using her elemental disciple level as her sorcerer level to determine the bonuses gained. This ability does not grant bonus spells to a sorcerer or bloodrager unless she possesses spell slots of an appropriate level. Such bonus spells are automatically granted if the sorcerer or bloodrager gains spell slots of the spell’s level.

Natural Armor Increase (Ex)

At 1st, 4th, and 7th level, an elemental disciple’s skin toughens, causing a cumulative increase to her natural armor bonus of +1.

Ability Boost

As her body slowly fortifies through the connection with her element, an elemental disciple gains stat boosts as noted on Table 11: Elemental Disciple.

These increases stack and are gained as if through level advancement. At 2nd and 4th level, a disciple gains +2 to Con (for deep earth, elemental earth, and shaitan bloodlines) or Dex (for djinni, efreeti, elemental air, elemental fire, elemental water, marid, and stormborn bloodlines); at 6th, +2 to Str; and at 8th, +2 to Wis.

Bloodline Feat

Upon reaching 2nd level, and every three levels thereafter, an elemental disciple receives one bonus feat, chosen from her sorcerer bloodline’s bonus feat list or from her bloodrager bloodline’s bonus feat list, depending on which one she is advancing with her level progression.

Elemental Assault

At 2nd level, an elemental disciple gains 1 extra use per day of her 1st-level bloodline power. She gains another extra use per day of the power for every 2 elemental disciple levels she possesses after 2nd.

Darkvision (Ex)

At 5th level, the elemental disciple gains darkvision with a range of 30 feet. If she already possessed darkvision, the ability range increases by 30 feet instead. At 10th level, the elemental disciple adds another 30 feet to her darkvision range.

Elemental Form (Sp)

At 3rd level, an elemental disciple begins to transform into a true elemental. She can assume an elemental form matching her elemental bloodline once per day. This ability works like elemental body I. At 7th level, this ability functions as elemental body III and can be used twice per day; at 10th level, it functions as elemental body IV and the elemental disciple can use this ability three times per day. Her caster level for this effect is equal to her effective sorcerer or bloodrager levels for her bloodline. If the disciple already has the ability to transform into an elemental (as with a druid’s wildshape ability or the efreeti bloodline’s efreeti form power), she can instead use it one more time per day. A deep earth disciple transforms into an earth elemental, while a stormborn disciple transforms into a lightning elemental.

Elemental Movement (Su)

At 9th level, an elemental disciple gains the elemental movement bloodline power, even if she doesn’t normally possess that power. Once her level is high enough to grant this ability through the bloodline, the elemental disciple’s speed when using her elemental movement increases by 30 feet. A deep earth disciple applies this ability to her earth glide bloodline power, while a stormborn disciple applies it to her ride the lightning power.
